classification.difficultyReason: Relate folded-sheet dimensions to a symmetric polygon and calculate its base using Pythagoras.

content.prompt: The rectangular sheet depicted below has dimensions $20\text{ cm}$ by $30\text{ cm}$. It is folded to form the seven-sided vertically symmetric figure on the right. Find the perimeter of the seven-sided figure if quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rectangle.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 14 paired sheet and folded figure
spec.description: Original landscape rectangle on the left; symmetric seven-sided folded outline on the right. The left strip is rectangle ABCD, with internal boundaries DC and CG. Decorative blue fills are omitted.
spec.mathematics: The sheet is 30 by 20. AB=CD=20 and AD=BC=5. The two central sloping sides meet at a right angle, giving the horizontal base length 20√2.
spec.answerVisibility: No numerical solution labels are printed in the question figure.

answer.short:
$(60+20\sqrt{2})\text{ cm}$.

The folded strips have widths $5\text{ cm}$; use Pythagoras for the base.
answer.worked:
$AB=CD=20\text{ cm}$. Since the two folded strips have equal widths,
$$\begin{align*}AD&=\frac{30-CD}{2}\\AD&=\frac{30-20}{2}\\AD&=5\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
The central triangle is right-angled, with its two sloping sides each $20\text{ cm}$. Let its base be $b$.
$$\begin{align*}b^2&=20^2+20^2\\b^2&=800\\b&=20\sqrt{2}\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
The outside boundary contains two sides of length $20\text{ cm}$, four sides of length $5\text{ cm}$ and the base.
$$\begin{align*}P&=2(20)+4(5)+20\sqrt{2}\\P&=(60+20\sqrt{2})\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
